def choose_move(observation):
    x, y = observation['self_position']
    targets = observation.get('resources', []) + observation.get('opponent_position', [])
    def dist(a,b): return abs(a[0]-b[0]) + abs(a[1]-b[1])
    if targets:
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: dist((x,y), t))
    else:
        target = None
    dx = dy = 0
    if target:
        if target[0] > x: dx = 1
        elif target[0] < x: dx = -1
        if target[1] > y: dy = 1
        elif target[1] < y: dy = -1
        if abs(target[0]-x) > abs(target[1]-y): dy = 0
        elif abs(target[1]-y) > abs(target[0]-x): dx = 0
    return [dx, dy]
